title: Grupo San Cristobal
description: gruposancristobal.com.mx Grupo San Cristóbal is a Mexican group of companies based in Mexico City, founded by Cristian Montalvo Flores, offering property management, accounting, construction, insurance and legal services across 10 plus business units. With over 250 employees, 500 clients and 2,800 properties under management, it provides full-cycle services for property owners and businesses. Its property management division handles condominium administration, maintenance, security, budgeting and owner meetings. Accounting services include bookkeeping, tax filings, payroll and audits for Mexican businesses. The construction arm delivers new builds, remodeling and preventive maintenance. The group's motto is Your Happiness Is Our Business, and it continues expanding its service portfolio across Mexico.
